name: Cast AI
summary:
Cast AI provides Kubernetes automation and optimisation technologies that help organisations improve infrastructure efficiency, cost management, and cluster operations across cloud environments.  

Together, we help organisations design, integrate, and operate Cast AI environments across secure Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure platforms. From workload optimisation and autoscaling through to operational governance and platform efficiency, we help teams create scalable, resilient, and cost-effective Kubernetes environments.
overview:
Cast AI technologies help organisations simplify Kubernetes operations through intelligent automation, optimisation, and cloud cost management. The platform focuses on Kubernetes optimisation, workload automation, cost monitoring, and application performance automation across cloud-native environments.  

Together, we help organisations build, integrate, and operate Cast AI environments across cloud and enterprise Kubernetes infrastructure. From cluster optimisation and workload automation through to operational governance and infrastructure visibility, we help teams create environments that are efficient, scalable, and operationally consistent.

Our focus is on building modern Kubernetes platform foundations that support long-term operational efficiency. This includes automation, observability, workload optimisation, lifecycle management, platform security, and operational enablement across complex cloud-native environments.

We help organisations reduce infrastructure waste, improve platform resilience, and operate Kubernetes environments with greater confidence and efficiency.
